component.name: Headroom
component.summary: Monitor AI account usage and resets

description.p: Headroom tracks usage, reset times, earned resets, and usage history across multiple ChatGPT and Codex accounts in one desktop dashboard.
It connects to the Codex CLI installed on your computer. Account names come from email and workspace information. Monitoring does not send model prompts or redeem resets.
The Flatpak stores settings and credentials in its private application data directory. It uses Flatpak host-command access to run your installed Codex CLI and manage its own optional startup entry.
